## What changed?

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran `npm run verify`.
- [ ] I tested the affected user-facing behavior.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation if behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, session cookies, or private user data.
- [ ] I did not invent unavailable Sim Companies data or silently replace missing values with zero.
- [ ] Any new Sim Companies upstream access goes through the existing paced upstream client.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out assumptions, trade-offs, migrations, security implications, or anything else that deserves extra attention.
